recipe.name: Aster / Delft clay / 14k gold
recipe.calibration_note: Starting alloy shrink allowance; confirm with a measured shop trial.

manufacturing.bench_notes: Solid 14k gold signet. Two-part Delft clay pattern with Z=0 parting and opposed Z withdrawal. All visible ornament is included in the cast pattern. Cut the gate, dress the seam and polish the raised relief; retain a satin ground. No stones or deep gallery pockets. Review low-draft regions and confirm release and fill in a physical shop trial. Gate layout and alloy shrink allowance are preliminary.
